paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: comparison by language family.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of task counts across various language families, specifically for three categories: "better" (mBERT), "XLM-R", and "same". The horizontal axis lists nine language families in the following order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indo-European (IE)-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "task count", has a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 40, marked at intervals of 10. Each language family has three bars representing the "better" (light blue), "XLM-R" (dark blue), and "same" (green) categories. The approximate values for each bar are as follows: IE-Baltic (better: 6, XLM-R: 9, same: 7), IE-Germanic (better: 4, XLM-R: 17, same: 22), IE-Indic (better: 2, XLM-R: 4, same: 3), IE-Romance (better: 11, XLM-R: 12, same: 32), IE-Slavic (better: 11, XLM-R: 38, same: 29), IE-other (better: 5, XLM-R: 6, same: 8), Isolate (better: 1, XLM-R: 2, same: 1), Semitic (better: 1, XLM-R: 5, same: 1), and Uralic (better: 1, XLM-R: 14, same: 5). No bars are sorted in a specific way or visually emphasized, aside from the use of different colors to differentiate between the categories. The bars are grouped by language family, with each group consisting of the three categories.
